goal: Remove AssumeUTXO snapshot loading, background sync, and multi-chainstate infrastructure.
Eliminate pervasive synchronization complexity across block download, caching, and storage for maintainers.
reviewability: Needs rebase due to conflicts with master, but reviewing the logic now is worthwhile.
agreement: Concept approval to cut high maintenance costs and return to standard trust assumptions (ismaelsadeeq)
Concept approval due to low adoption, lack of bandwidth savings, and ongoing bug burdens (instagibbs)
Unaddressed objection: removes a 100x bootstrap speedup, so drop background sync first (Sjors)
Suggests keeping it as an optional IPC companion process to reduce maintenance burden (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because collapsing multi-chainstate infrastructure removes pervasive validation complexity.
Removing concurrent chainstates eliminates special-casing in block download, storage, and caching.
Resolving whether to maintain this architectural burden has durable strategic value for validation.
